resources.string: A mark is a report, not advice. Every setup sees one symbol on one timeframe, and none of them marks a bar that has not closed.
Buys the bar the fast Hull average closed above the slow one, and sells the mirror. It has no trend filter, so it fires repeatedly in a market going nowhere.
The bar on which SuperTrend changed side, with the stop on the line itself. In a market without a trend it flips again and again.
A close above the roof or below the floor of the channel formed by the bars before it, in the direction of a long average. A channel is a window, not a level anybody is watching.
Price turning back inside the band while the RSI is still stretched. In a strong trend every one of its signals loses.
Entry in the direction of a long average when the stochastic turns back out of its extreme. It cannot tell a pause from the start of a reversal.
The bar on which trend, momentum and volatility first agree. All three are built from the same closes, so their agreement counts for less than it looks.
Four yes-or-no readings added together, marked on the bar the total reached the threshold. A score of 4 is not four times the evidence of a score of 1.
The first bar all three agree, with a stop and target taken from the symbol own volatility. It marks the beginning and says nothing about the end.
Channel break with CCI and momentum
A channel break confirmed by CCI and by rate of change. Its old name carried the word volume; no part of it ever read volume.
A Tenkan and Kijun cross taken only on the right side of the cloud — the cloud the chart draws at that bar, not the calculation made on it. The Chikou span is deliberately absent.
A +DI and −DI cross taken only while the ADX says a trend is present. The ADX lags: by the time it clears its threshold, part of the move has already happened.
The chart still shows the previous run
The script ran without an error and drew nothing. Use plot or marker to see a result.
One trade is still open and is not in the figures above.
Filled at the next bar\'s open, with no fee and no slippage; one trade at a time.
This input declares no range; change its value in the code.
The script declares no target, so no risk/reward is worked out.

fast = ta.ema(close, input.int(12, title = "Fast"))
slow = ta.ema(close, input.int(26, title = "Slow"))
plot(fast, title = "Fast", color = color.gold)
plot(slow, title = "Slow", color = color.blue)
marker(ta.crossover(fast, slow) and confirmed, title = "Buy", style = "up")
marker(ta.crossunder(fast, slow) and confirmed, title = "Sell", style = "down")

r = ta.rsi(close, input.int(14, title = "Length"))
plot(r, title = "RSI", pane = "own")
hline(70, pane = "own")
hline(30, pane = "own")
bgcolor(r > 70, color.new(color.sell, 85))
bgcolor(r < 30, color.new(color.buy, 85))
A label on the last bar
label.new(bar_index, high, \"close \" + str.tostring(close), color = color.gold)\nline.new(bar_index - 20, ta.lowest(low, 20), bar_index, ta.lowest(low, 20), color = color.blue)

fast = ta.ema(close, 9)
slow = ta.ema(close, 21)
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, when = ta.crossover(fast, slow))
strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, when = ta.crossunder(fast, slow))
